---
title: "Home"
---

Fixture for the global focus ring. Every focusable control must show the
same ring: a `$focus-ring-outer-color` outline, with the inner color as a
box-shadow in the outline offset.

Below 992px the secondary nav shows the sidebar toggle and sidebar search
buttons, which are bare Bootstrap `.btn` elements (#14774).

An [inline link](about.qmd) in the body.
